fail_closed_rules: Market-specific eligibility requires an exact destination country.
Unknown market eligibility statuses are hidden.
A shipping pass never overrides product truth, market policy, final-profit, payment, tax/import or Owner Gate.
Unmapped policy markets may be researched in Shadow but remain HOLD for real-money launch.
No provider becomes launch-eligible merely because the country gate passes.
Checkout, fulfillment and supplier order submission remain separate material gates.

shipping_discovery_summary.note: Counts are from the controlled seven-product EPROLO sample only; they are not global market rankings or launch claims.

runtime_rule: For every exact destination, evaluate exact variant + fresh stock + current shipping quote + visual/spec truth + market policy + final profit. Never infer one country from a region or another country.
provider_activation_rule: EPROLO may be evaluated globally in SHADOW before persisted storefront discovery is enabled. Production discovery remains disabled until provider-level final-profit and launch gates pass.

global_operating_model.shadow_rule: A product may be SHADOW_ELIGIBLE in one destination and BLOCKED/HOLD in another.
global_operating_model.live_rule: LIVE requires every independent gate to PASS for the exact destination; a shipping pass alone never implies launch eligibility.
global_operating_model.unknown_country_rule: HOLD until shipping + market policy are mapped and reviewed.
